Woman's body found in septic tank; live-in partner accused of murder

A woman's decomposed body was discovered hidden in a septic tank in Korba. The discovery was made after a foul smell emanated from the tank. The deceased was reportedly the live-in partner of the accused, who is now on the run. The incident has been described as shocking.
